name: FRED macro data
description: US and global macroeconomic series from the Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED): Treasury yields, the yield curve, inflation, unemployment, policy rates and more. Use series IDs such as DGS10, T10Y2Y, CPIAUCSL, UNRATE or FEDFUNDS as symbols.

provider.label: FRED (St. Louis Fed)
provider.notes: Official FRED API. Symbols are FRED series IDs. Observations are daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly; the currency field carries the series' units (for example Percent). Not market prices.
